metadata.notes: Angular SPA. No auth gate — all routes publicly accessible. Tag TODAY (id='TODAY') and project INBOX_PROJECT (id='INBOX_PROJECT') are built-in defaults. Focus overlay blocks all other routes while active. Onboarding appears on first run only (overlay, not a route).

nodes.label: Tag task view – work view with today/overdue/backlog task lists
actions: Open work context menu [button 'more_vert' in header]
Open Task View Customizer [button 'tune' in header]
nodes.notes: Main work view. Default landing route (Today tag). Guard: ValidTagIdGuard, FocusOverlayOpenGuard.

nodes.label: Project task view – work view with project task list + backlog
actions: Open work context menu [button 'more_vert' in header]
Restore archived project [button 'Restore' in archived notice]
nodes.notes: Project work view. Shows archived notice banner when project is archived. Guard: ValidProjectIdGuard.

nodes.label: History / Worklog – year/month/week breakdown of worked tasks
actions: Navigate to daily summary for day [link on day row]
nodes.notes: Also reachable as /tag/:id/worklog and /tag/:id/quick-history (legacy redirects).

nodes.label: Project History / Worklog – year/month/week breakdown
actions: Navigate to daily summary for day [link on day row]
nodes.notes: Same component as tag history. Also at /project/:id/worklog (legacy redirect).

nodes.label: Daily Summary – review tasks, evaluate day, plan tomorrow
actions: Switch to Review Tasks tab [tab '1. Review Tasks']
Switch to Evaluate Day tab [tab '2. Evaluate Day']
Switch to Plan Tomorrow tab [tab '3. Plan Tomorrow']
Mark all undone tasks as done [button]
Finish day and navigate back [button 'Back to work']
nodes.notes: Shows today's summary. Tab 3 only shown if isForToday=true.

nodes.label: Daily Summary for specific date
actions: Switch to Review Tasks tab [tab '1. Review Tasks']
Switch to Evaluate Day tab [tab '2. Evaluate Day']
nodes.notes: Historical daily summary. No 'Plan Tomorrow' tab since not today.

nodes.label: Project Daily Summary – review project tasks for today
actions: Switch to Review Tasks tab [tab '1. Review Tasks']
Switch to Evaluate Day tab [tab '2. Evaluate Day']
nodes.notes: Same component as tag daily summary but in project context.

nodes.label: Metrics – productivity stats, activity heatmap, focus sessions
actions: Open Focus Session Edit dialog [button in metrics]
nodes.notes: Only available for TODAY tag and projects (guard in work-context-menu).

nodes.label: Project Metrics – productivity stats for a project
nodes.notes: Same component as tag metrics but scoped to project data.

nodes.label: Settings page with 6 tabs: General, Tasks, Time & Tracking, Productivity, Plugins, Sync & Backup
actions: Copy version to clipboard [link version string]
nodes.notes: Tab index selectable via ?tab=N query param. Section expanded via ?section=key.

nodes.label: Settings – General tab: language, app features, misc, keyboard shortcuts
nodes.notes: Default tab (index=0). Theme selector at top, then collapsible sections.

nodes.label: Settings – Tasks tab: task settings, short syntax, sound
nodes.notes: Tab index=1.

nodes.label: Settings – Time & Tracking tab: time tracking, idle, schedule, reminders
nodes.notes: Tab index=2.

nodes.label: Settings – Productivity tab: focus mode, take-a-break, evaluation
nodes.notes: Tab index=3. CSS class 'tour-productivityHelper'.

nodes.label: Settings – Plugins tab: plugin management, plugin shortcuts
actions: Open plugin config dialog [button in plugin list]
Expand Keyboard Shortcuts for plugins section
nodes.notes: Tab index=4.

nodes.label: Settings – Sync & Backup tab: sync provider, import/export
actions: Set up sync [button 'Set Up Sync' - when no provider]
nodes.notes: Tab index=5. Sync status pill shown when provider configured.

nodes.label: Search – search all tasks including archived
actions: Navigate to task [click search result row]
Navigate to subtask parent [click result with parentTitle]
nodes.notes: Feature-flagged: only shows in nav when isSearchEnabled=true.

nodes.label: Scheduled List – all repeated tasks and time-scheduled tasks
actions: Edit task repeat config [click repeat text/icon on task]
Edit repeatable task title [task-title inline edit]
View scheduled tasks list [section below repeating tasks]
nodes.notes: Shows repeat configs and tasks with dueWithTime.

nodes.label: Planner – drag tasks onto calendar days
actions: Drag task to a day [drag-drop cdkDropList]
Schedule task via dialog [button or right-click on task]
Add task inline on a day [add-task-inline component]
nodes.notes: Feature-flagged: isPlannerEnabled. Mobile shows date nav at top.

nodes.label: Schedule – calendar view of tasks with time (week or month)
actions: Toggle calendar provider visibility [menu item in calFilterMenu]
Click event to open schedule-day-panel [schedule event]
nodes.notes: Feature-flagged: isSchedulerEnabled.

nodes.label: Schedule – Week view showing 7 days
actions: Click day column to open schedule-day-panel [schedule-week day column]
nodes.notes: Default view for /schedule.

nodes.label: Schedule – Month view showing calendar grid
actions: Click day cell to open schedule-day-panel [schedule-month day cell]
nodes.notes: Activated by clicking month view button.

nodes.label: Boards – Kanban-style boards as tabs
actions: Select board tab [mat-tab for each board]
Drag to reorder board tabs [cdkDrag on tab label]
Right-click board tab [context menu with edit/duplicate/delete]
Switch to Add New Board tab [mat-tab icon='add_circle']
nodes.notes: Feature-flagged: isBoardsEnabled.

nodes.label: Boards – Add New Board tab with inline board-edit form
actions: Save new board [button in board-edit form]
nodes.notes: Inline form shown in mat-tab with add_circle icon.

nodes.label: Habits – habit tracker with simple counters
nodes.notes: Feature-flagged: isHabitsEnabled.

nodes.label: Archived Projects – list of archived/completed projects
nodes.notes: Shows both archived and completed (isDone) projects.

nodes.label: Donate – GitHub Sponsors link
actions: Open GitHub Sponsors link [button mat-raised-button 'Support Development']
nodes.notes: Feature-flagged: isDonatePageEnabled. Hidden on iOS native per App Store rules.

nodes.label: Contrast Test – developer page for theme contrast testing
nodes.notes: No FocusOverlayOpenGuard. Dev/testing utility page.

nodes.label: Plugin Index – full-page plugin UI embedding
actions: Interact with plugin UI [plugin-index component iframe/content]
nodes.notes: Renders plugin's full-page UI via PluginIndexComponent.

nodes.label: Active work context redirect – auto-redirects to current tag/project
nodes.notes: Guard: ActiveWorkContextGuard. Immediately redirects; no visible UI.

nodes.label: Onboarding – first-run preset selection overlay
actions: Set up sync before starting [button 'Set up sync']
nodes.notes: Shown only on first run (isShowOnboardingPresets=true). Covers entire app.

nodes.label: Global Add Task Bar – floating input bar for adding tasks
actions: Type task title with short-syntax [input add-task-bar]
Assign to project/tag via autocomplete [add-task-bar autocomplete]
Submit task [Enter key or submit button]
nodes.notes: Shown when layoutService.isShowAddTaskBar()=true. Covers page with backdrop.

nodes.label: Focus Mode – main session view with Pomodoro/Flowtime timer
nodes.notes: FocusScreen.Main. Guard FocusOverlayOpenGuard blocks other routes while active.

nodes.label: Focus Mode – 5-second countdown before session starts
nodes.notes: Shown during 5-second prep. Animated rocket launch.

nodes.label: Focus Mode – Break timer between Pomodoro cycles
nodes.notes: FocusScreen.Break. Shown between pomodoro work sessions.

nodes.label: Focus Mode – Session complete screen with stats
nodes.notes: FocusScreen.SessionDone. Shown when Pomodoro work session completes.

nodes.label: Work view + Task Detail right panel open
actions: Close panel [click elsewhere or toggle button]
nodes.notes: panelContent='TASK'. Task selected in task list shows right panel.

nodes.label: Project work view + Task Detail right panel open
nodes.notes: Same panel content as tag context.

nodes.label: Work view + Notes right panel open
actions: Drop image to create note [drag image file onto notes]
Close notes panel [toggle button 'comment' in header]
nodes.notes: panelContent='NOTES'. Feature-flagged: isProjectNotesEnabled.

nodes.label: Work view + Issue Panel right panel open
actions: Select issue provider tab [mat-tab with provider icon]
Drag issue tab to reorder [cdkDrag on tab]
Long-press tab to edit provider [longPress event]
Open Edit Issue Provider dialog [context action on tab]
Close issue panel [toggle button 'webhook' in header]
nodes.notes: panelContent='ISSUE_PANEL'. Multiple provider tabs (Jira, GitLab, etc.).

nodes.label: Schedule + Schedule Day Panel open (right panel)
actions: Add task to day [button in schedule-day-panel]
Close day panel [toggle or click elsewhere]
nodes.notes: panelContent='SCHEDULE_DAY_PANEL'. Opened by clicking calendar event.

nodes.label: Task Detail Dialog (mobile/overlay variant)
nodes.notes: dialog-task-detail-panel wraps task-detail-panel. Used on mobile or from search.

nodes.label: Time Estimate Dialog – set/edit time estimate for a task
nodes.notes: Opened from task detail panel or task hover controls.

nodes.label: Deadline Dialog – set task deadline with date/time picker
nodes.notes: Opened from task detail panel deadline field.

nodes.label: View Task Reminders Dialog – shows due/deadline reminders popup
actions: Mark task done [button in task row]
nodes.notes: Triggered automatically when task reminder fires.

nodes.label: Add Time for Other Day Dialog – retroactively log time on past days
nodes.notes: Accessible from time estimate dialog.

nodes.label: View Archived Task Dialog – read-only view of archived task
nodes.notes: Opened from search results when task is archived.

nodes.label: Edit Task Attachment Dialog – edit attachment title/URL
nodes.notes: Opened from task-attachment-list in task detail panel.

nodes.label: Edit Task Repeat Config Dialog – configure repeating task schedule
actions: Set start date [button 'Today / date' opens schedule dialog]
nodes.notes: Add mode or Edit mode. Also accessible from /scheduled-list.

nodes.label: Edit Tags for Task Dialog – add/remove tags on a task
nodes.notes: Opened from task detail panel tags section.

nodes.label: Select Date/Time Dialog – general date+time picker
nodes.notes: Used for scheduling tasks from repeat config dialog.

nodes.label: Create Project Dialog – create a new project with name/icon/color
nodes.notes: Opened from sidebar 'add' button next to Projects section.

nodes.label: Project Complete Dialog – confirm project completion with stats
nodes.notes: Opened from work-context-menu 'Complete Project'.

nodes.label: Work Context Settings Dialog – edit project/tag settings (title, icon, theme)
nodes.notes: Opened from work-context-menu 'Settings'.

nodes.label: Create Tag Dialog – create a new tag with name/color
nodes.notes: Opened from sidebar 'add' button next to Tags section.

nodes.label: Idle Dialog – what were you doing during idle period?
nodes.notes: Triggered automatically after idle period. isTaskDataLoadedIfNeeded guard.

nodes.label: Tracking Reminder Dialog – track untracked time to a task
nodes.notes: Periodic popup when untracked time builds up.

nodes.label: Finish Day Before Close Dialog – shown on Electron window close
actions: Finish day and quit [button 'Finish Day' e2e='finishDayBtn']
nodes.notes: Electron-only. Shown when closing app with unfinished tasks.

nodes.label: Sync Config Dialog – configure sync provider and settings
actions: Enter provider credentials [form fields per provider]
nodes.notes: Opened from Settings Sync tab 'Set Up Sync' or 'Configure' buttons.

nodes.label: Enable Encryption Dialog – set encryption password for sync
nodes.notes: Nested dialog from Sync Config Dialog.

nodes.label: Change Encryption Password Dialog
nodes.notes: Nested dialog from Sync Config Dialog.

nodes.label: Sync Conflict Dialog – resolve data conflict between local and remote
nodes.notes: Appears automatically when sync detects a conflict.

nodes.label: Restore Point Dialog – restore from a sync backup point
actions: Select restore point [list of restore points]
nodes.notes: Part of the sync/IMEX feature.

nodes.label: Get and Enter Auth Code Dialog – OAuth flow for sync provider
nodes.notes: Used for Dropbox, WebDAV OAuth flows.

nodes.label: Import from URL Dialog – import SuperProductivity data from a URL
nodes.notes: Opened from Settings Sync & Backup tab IMEX section.

nodes.label: Worklog Export Dialog – export worklog data in various formats
actions: Select export format [dropdown/radio: CSV, JSON, Markdown]
nodes.notes: Opened from History view export button.

nodes.label: Logs Dialog – view application log history
nodes.notes: Opened from Settings footer 'Logs' link.

nodes.label: Clipboard Images Manager Dialog – manage cached clipboard images
nodes.notes: Opened from General settings Clipboard Images section.

nodes.label: Edit Simple Counter Dialog – edit counter value/session
nodes.notes: Opened from simple counter button long press.

nodes.label: Simple Counter Settings Dialog – configure a simple counter/habit
nodes.notes: Accessible from habit tracker or header counter button.

nodes.label: Edit Issue Provider Dialog – configure Jira, GitLab, GitHub, etc.
nodes.notes: Opened from issue panel tab long-press or setup overview.

nodes.label: Board Edit Dialog – configure a Kanban board (columns, filters)
nodes.notes: Opened from Boards page context menu 'Edit'.

nodes.label: Schedule Task Dialog (Planner) – schedule task to a day with time
nodes.notes: Opened from planner task or add-task-inline on a day.

nodes.label: Pomodoro Settings Dialog – work/break duration, cycles count
actions: Set cycles before long break [number input]
nodes.notes: Opened from Focus Mode main screen settings button.

nodes.label: Flowtime Settings Dialog – configure flowtime break ratios
nodes.notes: Opened from Focus Mode main screen when Flowtime mode selected.

nodes.label: Focus Session Edit Dialog – edit focus session data in metrics
nodes.notes: Opened from Metrics page focus session list.

nodes.label: Productivity Breakdown Dialog – detailed productivity stats
nodes.notes: Opened from Metrics page.

nodes.label: User Profile Management Dialog – create/switch/rename profiles
actions: Edit profile name [button 'edit' on profile row]
nodes.notes: Opened from user-profile-button in header. Feature-flagged: isEnableUserProfiles.

nodes.label: Fullscreen Markdown Dialog – full-screen editor for task notes
nodes.notes: Opened from task detail panel notes section expand button.

nodes.label: Markdown Shortcuts Dialog – reference for markdown syntax
nodes.notes: Opened from Fullscreen Markdown Dialog help button.

nodes.label: Share Dialog – share content (tasks as markdown, stats)
actions: Share via native share [button 'Share' on supported devices]
nodes.notes: Opened from share-button components in Metrics, work-context-menu.

nodes.label: Generic Confirm Dialog – yes/no confirmation
nodes.notes: Reused for delete confirmations, experimental feature warnings, etc.

nodes.label: GitLab Submit Worklog Dialog – submit time to GitLab issue
nodes.notes: GitLab-specific dialog for worklog submission.

nodes.label: Jira Transition Dialog – move Jira issue to a different status
nodes.notes: Jira-specific. Opened when completing a Jira-linked task.

nodes.label: OpenProject Transition Dialog – change OpenProject work package status
nodes.notes: OpenProject-specific dialog.

nodes.label: Please Rate Dialog – app rating/feedback prompt
actions: Give feedback [button 'Give Feedback' shows feedback form]
nodes.notes: Periodically shown after extended app use. Has main and feedback sub-views.

nodes.label: Track Time to Issue Dialog – log time spent on an issue
nodes.notes: Issue-provider shared dialog for tracking time to issue providers.

nodes.label: Add Note Dialog – create a new note in current work context
nodes.notes: Opened from notes panel 'Add Note' button.

nodes.label: Confirm URL Import Dialog – confirm before importing from URL
nodes.notes: Shown after entering URL in Import from URL dialog.

nodes.label: Enter Encryption Password Dialog – decrypt synced data
nodes.notes: Shown when sync data is encrypted and password is needed.

nodes.label: Handle Decrypt Error Dialog – options when decryption fails
nodes.notes: Shown when decryption of sync data fails.

nodes.label: Import Encryption Warning Dialog – warning before importing encrypted data
nodes.notes: Shown when importing data that was encrypted.

nodes.label: Legacy Migration Dialog – migrate from old data format
nodes.notes: Appears once on first load after upgrading from legacy version.

nodes.label: Server Migration Confirm Dialog – confirm SuperSync server data migration
nodes.notes: SuperSync server-specific migration dialog.

nodes.label: Sync Import Conflict Dialog – resolve op-log import conflict
nodes.notes: Op-log level conflict dialog (different from dialog-sync-conflict).

nodes.label: Generic Prompt Dialog – single text input prompt
nodes.notes: Reusable dialog for simple text input (e.g., bug report URL entry).

nodes.label: Unsplash Background Picker Dialog – search and select background image
nodes.notes: Opened from theme settings when selecting a background image.

nodes.label: Disable Profiles Confirmation Dialog – confirm disabling user profiles feature
nodes.notes: Shown when disabling user profiles with multiple existing profiles.

nodes.label: Archive Compression Dialog – compress task archive
nodes.notes: Accessible from settings or archive management.

nodes.label: Work view + Task View Customizer dropdown open (sort/group/filter)
actions: Sort tasks by field [customizer Sort sub-menu]
Group tasks by field [customizer Group By sub-menu]
nodes.notes: mat-menu dropdown from filter_list button in page-title. Changes task list sort/group/filter.

nodes.label: Work view + Plugin side panel open
actions: Switch active plugin [plugin side panel buttons]
Close plugin panel [toggle plugin button in header]
nodes.notes: panelContent='PLUGIN'. Shown when a plugin registers a side panel.

edges.trigger: click on task row in task list
button 'add' in header [class='tour-addBtn'] or mobile FAB
button 'hourglass' or time estimate in task hover controls
button 'flag' deadline in task detail panel
button 'label' tags in task detail panel
button 'close' panel or clicking outside panel
button 'expand' in notes section of task detail
button 'comment' to toggle off notes panel
button 'webhook' to toggle off issue panel
button 'Skip Break' or auto: break timer ends
button 'close' at top of focus overlay
button settings icon in focus mode (Pomodoro mode)
button settings icon in focus mode (Flowtime mode)
click on task row in task list
button schedule task in planner-task component
click on schedule event or day column
click on day cell in month calendar
context menu item 'Edit' on board tab
button 'Set Up Sync' or 'Configure' in Sync summary
click on day row in worklog week section
button 'Back to work' after finishing day
click repeat text/icon on task card
button backdrop click or Escape key
auto: preset selected and app loads
button 'Save' or 'Cancel' in time estimate dialog
button planned start date in repeat cfg dialog
button 'help' / keyboard shortcuts icon in fullscreen editor
click on focus session row in metrics
button 'Open Full Page' in plugin management
button 'Save' or 'Cancel' in add note dialog
button 'Pick from Unsplash' in theme background settings
click outside customizer menu or Escape key
button plugin icon in header plugin-side-panel-btns
button plugin icon again to toggle off

auth_zones.label: No authentication required — all routes are publicly accessible

layouts.label: Main app shell: sidebar nav + header + right panel + router outlet
Full-screen focus mode overlay (blocks all app-shell routes)
